title: The Accuracy Well: Nonmonotone Accuracy Dynamics at Vanishing Initialization
abstract: arXiv:2610.20439v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study classification dynamics under small initialization and identify a pronounced non-monotone behavior of accuracy that we call the accuracy well: accuracy rises rapidly early in training, subsequently drops, and only much later recovers. We observe this phenomenon in deep linear networks, fully connected ReLU networks on MNIST, deep convolutional networks on CIFAR-10, and controlled synthetic tasks, across different losses and optimizers and in both training and test accuracy. We propose a three-stage explanation in terms of target-driven organization, a degeneracy bottleneck, and subsequent recruitment and recovery. We develop a rigorous theory of these dynamics for shallow and deep linear networks, showing in particular that high accuracy can emerge while the predictor and the change in loss remain asymptotically vanishing, before continued optimization causes accuracy to deteriorate. translated_title: 精度之井：消失初始化下的非单调精度动态
translated_abstract: 我们研究了小初始化下的分类动态，并识别出一种显著的精度非单调行为，我们称之为“精度之井”：精度在训练早期快速上升，随后下降，直到很久之后才恢复。我们在深度线性网络、MNIST上的全连接ReLU网络、CIFAR-10上的深度卷积网络以及受控合成任务中观察到这一现象，且该现象跨越不同的损失函数和优化器，同时存在于训练精度和测试精度中。我们提出了一个三阶段的解释框架：目标驱动的组织、退化瓶颈，以及随后的招募与恢复。我们为浅层和深层线性网络建立了这些动态的严格理论，特别地表明：在预测器和损失变化保持渐近消失的同时，高精度就可能出现，而在持续优化之后精度才会恶化。对于一个简单的合成分类任务，我们……
tldr: 该论文发现小初始化训练神经网络时精度呈现非单调的“精度之井”现象——先快速上升、随后下降、很久后才恢复，并为浅层和深层线性网络建立了严格的三阶段理论解释。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a nonmonotone "accuracy well" phenomenon under vanishing initialization—accuracy rises rapidly early in training, then drops, and only much later recovers—and develops a rigorous three-stage theory explaining these dynamics in shallow and deep linear networks.
